scripts.setup:ddev: mkdir -p .ddev && [ -f .ddev/.env ] || cp .env.example .ddev/.env && export $(grep -v '^#' .ddev/.env | xargs) composer install && ddev config --docroot=website/public_html --project-type=php --webserver-type=apache-fpm --database=mysql:8.0 --nodejs-version=${NODE_VERSION} --default-container-timeout=240 && ddev start && ddev add-on get ddev/ddev-phpmyadmin && ddev restart
scripts.setup:ee: ddev php ./cli install && ddev php ./cli generate:boilerplate
scripts.setup:frontend: ddev npm install --loglevel=error && ddev npm run iconfonts
scripts.setup:website: composer run setup:frontend && composer run setup:ee && ddev npm run prod && ddev launch
